messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — NexSupply just sent a partial confirm for the 40x A100 batch we had backordered. They say 22 units ship this week, rest in two waves. Need to confirm insurance/serials before we accept.
Samir Khan: @Maya any ETA/airway bill yet? if insurance isn't covering full declared value we should pause acceptance.
Vendor Ops (NexSupply): FYI — AWB 1Z999AA10123456784 covers the first 22 units, expected arrival 2024-04-04 09:30 UTC. We flagged 18 units as delayed due to supplier line down. Insurance adjusted; carrier requested a serial manifest to validate.
Liam O'Connor: Can you attach a CSV with serials + model + condition? we need to reconcile against our internal pool and RMA reservations. minimal columns: `serial,sku,shipment_slot`.
Vendor Ops (NexSupply): uploading now — attaching inline: ``serials.csv
S12345,A100-40GB,slot1
S12346,A100-40GB,slot1
...`` (trimmed). Carrier also says declared value on the commercial invoice is $200k but our AM listed $215k. Insurance might reject a claim unless values match.
Juan Rivera: Ugh. Did procurement approve the final invoice? @Samir can you check PO vs invoice mismatch. If values differ we should ask vendor to reissue CI or provide written amendment for insurer.
Samir Khan: On it — opening PR with finance now. ETA for amendment? vendor?
Vendor Ops (NexSupply): We can reissue CI with corrected declared value within 24h. For the delayed 18 units, vendor is offering air-expedite but cost will be +6% on unit price. Do you want to accept split billing?
Maya Patel: Accept split shipment — but only if insurance covers both legs and we get serial manifest before carrier unload. Also need RMA-ready replacements reserved in our staging cluster in AMS to swap in for any DOA. Liam, can you reserve 10 units from warm pool?
Liam O'Connor: Reserving 10 A100s from warm pool in AMS now, will mark them as "hold: vendor backfill". If partial arrives DOA we can push replacements same-day.
FreightBot: Tracking update: AWB 1Z999AA10123456784 cleared customs in FRA; ETA to AMS dock 2024-04-04 07:00 UTC. No holds flagged.
Samir Khan: Finance confirmed PO matches $215k. Vendor please reissue CI with $215k and include the AWB and serial manifest reference. We need the amended CI to submit to insurer.
Vendor Ops (NexSupply): Will reissue CI + attach final `serials.csv` and `packing_list.pdf`. Expected to send in ~6 hours.
Maya Patel: Great — once we have docs we will coordinate receiving team for verification. Noted: queue a quick test bench pass on arrival and escalate any DOA to RMA within 2 business hours. :thumbsup:
Juan Rivera: One more ask — if the expedited remainder costs >6% can vendor push stock from their EU pool instead of air? might be cheaper.
Vendor Ops (NexSupply): Checking EU pool now, will advise within 2h.
Maya Patel: OK team — stand by for updated CI + serials. I'll patch the inbound manifest to show reserved replacements and notify on-call to expect paperwork.
